content.short: Quest platform that rewards people for trying new chains and apps, in USDC and SUPR.
content.description: Superboard runs quests and campaigns that walk users through real on-chain actions on new networks, from exploring Arc and Robinhood Chain mainnets to testing perps and AI agents. Completing them earns USDC, SUPR tokens or partner points, and curated series like The Alphalist introduce hand-picked projects. Protocols use it to reach active users rather than bots.
